messages:
michael_support: Heads up — Orchard Health trial blocked on production token exchange during onboarding. Customers seeing repeated 401s when exchanging auth code. They tried twice today and are frustrated. Renewal window in 18 days. Escalating to CS for priority handoff.

oncall-bot: New ticket created: #45678 (P1) — https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/45678 — metadata: product=redwood-api, severity=P1

elaine_csm: Thanks Michael. Adding to my queue. Can someone post a short timeline and who will own the technical fix? @sam_engineer? 🙏

sam_engineer: Looking at logs now. OAuth callback shows 403 from customer IdP for some token exchange requests. Hypothesis: client secret rotated on their side. I can push a temporary acceptance change to staging so onboarding can continue, but need AM to confirm prod client id before any prod deploy.

leo_account_manager: I just pinged the customer — they can access the dev client id but security team won't share prod creds yet. I recommended a 45m enablement call to walk through swapping credentials. Flagging renewal risk: if onboarding stalls >72h, risk -> medium-high.

michael_support: Draft comms plan below — please review/edit. If we agree I'll send and book the call.

michael_support: ```Comms plan (proposed):
- T+0: acknowledge to customer, open P1, set expectations (we own it). Owner: elaine_csm
- T+1h: enablement call (CS + AM + Eng) to obtain prod client id and live test creds
- T+2h: eng pushes temp acceptance to staging; confirm token exchange 200
- T+6h: with AM confirmation, deploy to prod and rotate credentials with customer
- T+24h: follow-up to confirm onboarding flow and capture success metrics
- Contingency: if unresolved at T+4h -> notify CSM director and exec sponsor; consider short-term credit if customer indicates commercial frustration
Escalation contacts: sam_engineer (eng), leo_account_manager (AM), elaine_csm (CS)
```

elaine_csm: I can run the call at 15:00 PT today. I'll use the abbreviated enablement checklist and request screen share of the IdP flow. Drafting the message now.

michael_support: Sample blurb to send to customer (please copy/edit):
"Hi Maya — thanks for flagging this. We're prioritizing your onboarding and have a small cross-functional team standing by. Can you join a quick 45-minute call today at 15:00 PT to swap credentials and verify the token exchange? We're seeing 401s from your IdP; likely a client secret mismatch. We'll walk through a safe rotation path. — Michael, Support"

leo_account_manager: Sending that now and asking them to confirm 15:00 PT. Preparing a short retention note for renewal team: if this completes today, renewal stays on track; if not, escalate to 1:1 outreach.

sam_engineer: Quick update: pushed temp acceptance to staging; token exchange returns 200 for test client id. I will not push to prod until AM confirms client id from customer. Logs attached to ticket.

michael_support: Commercial flag: customer mentioned evaluating alternatives during the stall. @leo_account_manager please coordinate renewal playbook touch if call slips. ⚠️

elaine_csm: Assigning owner in CS board -> task CS-812. I'll run the enablement call, capture screenshots, and update playbook with root cause + steps taken. After call I'll add a short success note for the renewal pack.

michael_support: After the call, paste verification steps into the ticket and add follow-up actions. If we need to offer a short-term concession, ping director first.

sam_engineer: Post-call plan (if confirmed): 1) prod deploy fix 2) creds rotate with customer 3) smoke test 4) mark ticket resolved and attach logs. ETA ~2h after call.

elaine_csm: Customer confirmed 15:00. Sending calendar invite with Zoom + agenda. Posting pre-call checklist in thread. 📆

leo_account_manager: Customer accepted. Preparing brief renewal note for director in case we need to stretch SLA timeframe.

oncall-bot: Ticket #45678 updated: status=investigating, assignees=[elaine_csm, sam_engineer], priority=P1

elaine_csm: Call complete — validated client id mismatch, rotated client secret, eng deployed to prod, smoke test passed. Customer can complete onboarding flow. Updating ticket with steps and closing loop. ✅

michael_support: Thanks everyone. Please add a one-paragraph summary to the renewal sheet noting time to resolve and customer sentiment for retention outreach.

elaine_csm: Summary posted to renewal sheet and CS board. Closing this handoff.
